t4.brief:
You are the Phase 5 integrator for the Dawri iOS app. You run every check in the Definition of done and fix whatever fails, anywhere under ios/. Repo: /Users/jaberal-boenain/Desktop/Dawri, branch build/dawri-ios. Never touch main, backend/ or frontend/. Never commit. Read first, in full: Dawri-Vault/08 iOS/iOS Brief.md (every line of the Definition of done), then Dawri-Vault/08 iOS/iOS Design.md sections 8 and 11, then Dawri-Vault/08 iOS/iOS Build Log.md, then ios/README.md, ios/Tools/clinic-server.sh, ios/Tools/server-proof.sh and ios/Tools/no-credit-check.sh.

NO-CREDIT RULES, ABSOLUTE:
- Never read, print or source .env. Never run hf. Never contact any *.hf.space, huggingface.co, hf.co or model provider host. Never redeploy.
- Start the backend only through ios/Tools/clinic-server.sh (HF_TOKEN= blank, temp DB, 127.0.0.1, port 8101-8199) and quote its 'ai_mode simulated' line each time. Stop it after, and confirm with pgrep -fl uvicorn.

SIMULATOR: you are the ONLY owner of 'Dawri Build' (B55FEAC2-08EB-460D-9261-E28A60F4B5CC) in this wave. Never name, boot or shut down F7E60EDF or the iPhone 17 C72FD56D. Never install anything on the physical iPhone.

HYGIENE: fresh -derivedDataPath and --scratch-path in the session scratchpad. Nothing built under ios/. Remove ios/DawriCore/.swiftpm afterwards.

POWER: before each long run, check pmset -g batt and pmset -g log, and wrap the run in caffeinate -i. A failure with 'Timed out while synthesizing event', a signal term, or a gap matching sleep or a CoreSimulatorService restart in the logs is environmental: rerun only those tests and report BOTH runs. Anything else is a bug: fix it and rerun.

RUN, IN ORDER, AND REPORT THE RAW EVIDENCE:
1. swift test --package-path ios/DawriCore --scratch-path <fresh>: total, 0 skipped, 0 warnings, and the safety golden suites by name (red flags single and conversation, refill, text, regex, parsers, read-back, next_turn, session replay, clinic and queue goldens, manifests). grep for XCTSkip, '.disabled(' and withKnownIssue in DawriCore/Tests and DawriUITests finds nothing.
2. ios/Tools/clinic-server.sh contract <fresh>: every ClinicContract case passes for both the on-this-phone and the clinic-server argument, with equal counts, against a real local backend in simulated mode.
3. python3 ios/Tools/sync-strings.py --check, export-engine-data --check and export-goldens --check, with HF_TOKEN= blank, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and a temp DAWRI_DB as before: exit 0.
4. Full xcodebuild test -scheme Dawri on Dawri Build from fresh derived data, after uninstalling com.jaber.dawri and rebooting Dawri Build. Report per suite. JourneyTests must show Fatima, Ahmed and Ravi in AR and EN in On this phone mode, with no server argument. The Dawri scheme must not run ServerModeTests.
5. ios/Tools/server-proof.sh <outdir>: passes. VIEW every stage screenshot (Connected, S10 with its number, called, serving, doctor D-GP-023, pharmacy P-031, S11 complete, the polling slow state) in EN and AR, and frames of the video. Confirm the server log shows only 127.0.0.1 and no /api/asr.
6. ios/Tools/shoot.sh <outdir>: the image count equals the rows in the tables times 4, plus 4 for each ax3 row, plus the island rows. VIEW every Settings row and any screen whose code changed in Phase 5, against iOS Design section 11. Colour scan with the method in the Build Log (top 170 px excluded, tolerance 30): no #1d5fbf or #689ce8 outside S10, the Live views and the galleries; no #c4242a above 1% outside S06.
7. Release simulator build: strings on the app binary and the extension finds none of demoScreen, demoMode, demoAddress, demoConnect, demoServer, demoClinic (if added), demoFail, demoHold, demoCamera, demoVoice, demoNotify, demoLiveProbe or demoFreeze, while the Debug dylib has them. The built Info.plist NSAppTransportSecurity is exactly {NSAllowsLocalNetworking: true}, NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription is in the ar.lproj and en.lproj InfoPlist.strings, and the appex has no ATS key.
8. Device:
   xcodebuild -project ios/Dawri.xcodeproj -scheme Dawri -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath <fresh> -allowProvisioningUpdates build
   - Then codesign -dvv and codesign -d --entitlements - on Dawri.app and DawriLiveExtension.appex: TeamIdentifier 4Y4YQ65B78, and no paid capability.
   - NEVER install it: no devicectl, ios-deploy or simctl install of this build.
   - If signing fails for an account reason, quote the exact error, show that the same build with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO succeeds, and say so plainly.
9. ios/Tools/no-credit-check.sh exits 0. Also run grep -rniE 'hf\.space|huggingface|hf\.co|novita|featherless|ovhcloud|openai|anthropic|api-inference|whisper|/api/asr' ios/ and classify every hit as a refusal guard, a guard test, or a banned-list. Then grep -rn URLSession ios/: only DawriCore/Sources/DawriCore/Remote and DawriUITests/ServerModeTests.swift.
10. git diff bb37797 -- backend frontend is empty. git status shows only ios/ and the allowed vault note changed. No build output and no .swiftpm under ios/. Dawri Build is shut down. No uvicorn is running.

FIX every failure you find, in any file under ios/, with a test where a test can catch it, then rerun the affected checks.
